title: Shows like Midst
description: Big-concept fiction with a strong narrator voice, strange systems, and enough propulsion to make the weirdness feel deliberate.
label: Worlds askew

showReasons.midnight-burger: A warmer cosmic branch if the big ideas mattered as much as the affection.
showReasons.ars-paradoxica: Keeps the conceptual ambition high while making the science spine more explicit.
showReasons.the-program-audio-series: A colder, more systems-minded branch for listeners who want the worldview to stay central.
showReasons.the-waystation: An exploratory route if the strange setting and sense of scale mattered more than the chaos.
showReasons.case-63: A tighter paradox-thriller branch when you want the brain-bending hook in a cleaner package.
showReasons.red-valley: Keeps the controlled weirdness and institutional mystery alive without chasing the same frontier sprawl.
